description.value: Maruhachi Ra-men is a ramen-focused restaurant located on Kingsway in Burnaby, offering dine-in and pickup service. It sits along a well-travelled urban corridor that connects cyclists moving through the Burnaby–Vancouver area. The cashless payment policy (Visa/Mastercard only) is worth noting for riders carrying only cash.
